name: Maracaibo

rounds.endCondition: Game ends after round IV when a ship reaches space 22 and final scoring is done

categories.label: Victory point track before final scoring
categories.labelVi: Điểm trên track trước khi tính cuối game
categories.hint: Your marker on the VP track after interim scoring and play.

categories.label: Final scoring choice: score 2 VP
categories.labelVi: Lựa chọn cuối game: lấy 2 VP
categories.hint: Tick if you chose to score 2 VP instead of buying a project card or investing.

categories.label: Victory point income track
categories.hint: VP at your marker position on the victory point income track.

categories.label: Doubloon income track (bonus VP)
categories.hint: Extra VP at your marker position on the doubloon income track.

categories.label: Project cards and prestige buildings
categories.labelVi: Thẻ dự án và công trình prestige
categories.hint: VP on each project card in display (incl. one bought in final scoring) and on prestige investments. Cards in hand score nothing.

categories.label: Nations where you lead influence
categories.labelVi: Quốc gia dẫn đầu ảnh hưởng
categories.hint: 3 VP per nation (France, Spain, England) where you have the most influence; ties each score; nothing if all markers still on 0.

categories.label: Noble ranks x nation multipliers
categories.labelVi: Cấp quý tộc x hệ số quốc gia
categories.hint: Per nation: noble rank (last red band reached) x multiplier (empty spaces + majority bonus 2/1/0 by ownership markers; ties get higher).

formula.expr: rankFrance * multFrance + rankSpain * multSpain + rankEngland * multEngland

tiebreakers.description: No tiebreaker: tied players are all winners.

notes: family: point-salad-euro. Multiplier per nation = number of its empty spaces (all nation markers removed) plus majority bonus (most markers on board 2, second 1; tied nations get the higher value; if two tie for first the third gets 0). Career card completions and campaign story cards are scored during play. Solo variant and Uprising expansion not modelled.
